patches_added.name: Modern UI
patches_added.description: [v1.3: A modern refresh of Joey's look] Joey's own themes and colour changes are turned off while this patch is on. Aqua is the default. Blue, Purple, Coral, Mint, Gold, Amber, Black, Sky, and AMOLED black are in Joey Settings - Morphe Settings. Posts use one compact list, so card and compact are no longer separate. patches_modified.name: GmsCore support
patches_modified.description: For phones that run microG-RE instead of Google Play services. Facebook asks microG-RE for its push notifications, and microG-RE gets the signature of Meta's own Facebook for the Google services that check one. Install microG-RE first. It isn't selected by default because Facebook then stops asking Google Play services, so on a phone without microG-RE push notifications stop and Google shows a notice asking you to get Play services. Turn on Expert mode in Manager to pick it. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
